WITH kept AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name, ds.points AS pts
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE ds.points > 1.0 AND r.name IS NOT NULL
),
per_race AS (
  SELECT race_name, AVG(pts) AS avg_pts
  FROM kept
  GROUP BY race_name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pts) AS overall_avg FROM per_race
)
SELECT p.race_name AS name,
       p.avg_pts AS avg_points,
       p.avg_pts - o.overall_avg AS diff
FROM per_race p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.avg_pts > o.overall_avg;
